description: Cloud AFK movement (services/cloud-afk/README.md, 'Movement'). settings: the movement keys of the features group with their defaults, and the fixed rules. shape: an operation as a client sends it in {"t":"move","acct","id","op"} and the problem (null: well-formed; else invalid {reason, field?}). gate: afk-host's movement gate: the state (service: Studio's switch and the machine's feat-move/1; running: in game; setting: the account's movement.enabled; client: what the running client can do, move | restart | slots | version; trade: an AFK+ deal; pos: the last reported position or null; self, server: the account's name and server; main: the host document's verified mainName or null; own: the player's other accounts on this machine {name, server, inGame}; startNames: the names the running client was started with, MCC_AGENT_FOLLOW) and the operation, then either the client bridge operations it sends (bridge version 3; 'log': the console line it writes) or the error {code, reason?}, checked in this order: shape; stop always passes (it stops what moves, else nothing); movement_off service, not_running, movement_off setting, movement_off restart | slots | version, busy_trade; then too_far for goto (the 3D distance from pos to the target block's centre above 256; no pos: the client checks), and for approach and follow: not_allowed (itself, a stranger, an own account on another server), not_visible (an own account not in game), movement_off restart (a name the client was not started with). rate: the per-account limits (afk-host's, and the Worker's in front of it) on operations the gate let through, over a sequence of [time in ms, action, target for goto]: the bucket (opsBurst, opsPerSecond), the rolling hour (opsPerHour), and the loop guard (a goto within 3 blocks of the targets of sameTargetPer10Min accepted gotos of the last 10 minutes is refused with loop); stop is free; a refused operation costs nothing; retryAfter in seconds. slots: the Worker's check when a PATCH turns movement on (null, limit_movement {scope, max} or invalid_config). view: Account.features.movement {mode, on, slot, follow {main, own}} from the switch, the machine's capability, the setting, the slot counts, the account, its server and serverKey, the player's link and other accounts. directions: the client's facing from its yaw (the game's rounding), the direction of a step relative to it (or a compass direction the bridge names), and the block offset of n steps. Generated by generate-move-op-v1.mjs; do not edit by hand.
